description: This file defines a simple circuit breaker implementation for managing request flow control and fault tolerance. It includes the CircuitBreaker class with state management, execution logic, and an exception class for open circuit scenarios.

classes.name: CircuitBreaker
classes.description: Implements a lightweight circuit breaker with configurable failure threshold and open duration. Manages state transitions between closed, open, and half-open states, and controls execution of asynchronous operations to prevent cascading failures.

classes.name: CircuitBreakerOpenException
classes.description: Custom exception thrown when the circuit breaker is open and requests are rejected.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Runs the provided asynchronous operation if the circuit breaker allows. Manages state transitions based on success or failure of the operation, and enforces open-closed logic.

methods.name: _onSuccess
methods.description: Resets failure count and closes the circuit upon successful operation.

methods.name: _onFailure
methods.description: Increments failure count and opens the circuit if failure threshold is exceeded.
